name: Sustainable Connections — local businesses
about: One dataset, three tools: the RCN Map (where), the Timeline (when each began) and the Table (everything, sortable). Each tool opened with ?set=sc-directory.set.json&sel=<id> opens its own view on that business. The id is the business's point id on the RCN Map; the Timeline carries it as each bar's id (and all of a business's points in its coops list), the Table as the mapId column. No graph: a directory has no ties. Paths are relative to this file. Built by tools/sc-directory/build.py and substrate/load_sc_directory.py. Marc Pierson with Claude Opus 5.5, Oct 2026.
